note: The ten pilot pairs (Al: all ten LOVE on the taste page, 25 Sept 2026). Joke first, then a photo made to set it up (review/taste/RECIPE.md on design/home-options). Photos remade 25 Sept with Al's realism brief by Sol in Codex on the ChatGPT Pro plan (Images 2.5 per Al's transparency test); sources: OneDrive copy review/taste/pilot-v2/Pxx.jpg. Each pair's line is its photo's own English line; the Afrikaans is Vonk's proposal for Al. Placement: first the slots of Al's five named photos where weather and time of day match (P01, P10), then the thinnest slots of the pair's own weather and time; where a weather is full (wind day, rain day) the pair takes the place of that bucket's weakest photo by the blind rater, shown to Al pre-marked. Nothing ships until review/pairs-ruled.json.

pairs.line: The sun has no indoor voice.
pairs.af: Die son het net een volume: hard.
pairs.why: Al named this photo (dad and kids on the grass); a clear-day pair fits its slots

pairs.line: The tar's gone soft. So have we.
pairs.af: Die teer het sag geword. Ons ook.
pairs.why: heat day has 7 photos for 14 slots; this takes weeks 2 and 4 of the weakest by the blind rater (office workers fanning), which stays on weeks 1 and 3

pairs.line: The wind took the washing. It's keeping the pegs.
pairs.af: Die wind het die wasgoed gevat. Die knypers mag ons maar hou.
pairs.why: wind day is full (14 photos, 14 slots); this takes the place of the one the blind rater failed because no wind shows in it (a still yard)
pairs.anchorNote: 22, not 40: on today's Home the band cut off the flying sheet, which is the joke's setup

pairs.line: Rain this hard, even the taxis start indicating.
pairs.af: Reën só hard, selfs die taxi's sit hul flikkers aan.
pairs.why: rain day is full (14 photos, 14 slots); this takes the place of the one the blind rater called corporate stock (a laughing umbrella duo)

pairs.line: The sky's been saying 'just now' for three hours.
pairs.af: Die lug sê nou al drie uur lank 'netnou'.
pairs.why: cloudy evenings have 6 photos; these four slots serve a stand-in since the dog photo moved to cold (it stays in cold)

pairs.line: Thunder that close counts as a house guest.
pairs.af: Donder so naby tel as 'n huisgas.
pairs.why: storm nights have 7 photos for 14 slots; this takes weeks 2 and 4 of the weakest by the blind rater (a staged roof-leak couple), which stays on weeks 1 and 3

pairs.line: The fog cancelled the Drakensberg. No refunds.
pairs.af: Die mis het die Drakensberg gekanselleer. Geen terugbetalings nie.
pairs.why: fog mornings have 7 photos for 14 slots; this takes weeks 2 and 4 of the weakest by the blind rater (a dark window glow), which stays on weeks 1 and 3

pairs.line: Cape cold doesn't knock. It comes in through the walls.
pairs.af: Kaapse koue klop nie. Dit kom sommer deur die mure in.
pairs.why: cold day slot 6 (weeks 2 and 4) serves a stand-in since the washing photo moved to cold-clear (it stays there). Not cold day slot 2: that holds photo #79's only copies (parked)

pairs.line: Blue sky, minus two. The sun's just here to watch.
pairs.af: Blou lug, minus twee. Die son is net hier om te kyk.
pairs.why: cold-clear mornings have 7 photos for 14 slots; this takes weeks 2 and 4 of the weakest by the blind rater (an empty windmill postcard), which stays on weeks 1 and 3

pairs.line: Karoo sky. You'll count to forty and give up.
pairs.af: Karoo-lug. Jy tel tot veertig en gee op.
pairs.why: Al named this photo (dinner under fairy lights); a clear-night pair fits its slots

lines: The sheets are dry already and the wind is not finished with them.
The Helderberg is clear, the washing is horizontal, and that is Sunday sorted.
That little olive tree is going to grow up with a permanent lean.
Nobody in this house is paying to dry anything today.
Those pegs are all that stands between you and a fence full of sheets.
Forgot your jacket? The universe noticed.
'Just one sundowner' — famous last words, every single time.
A Friday night warm enough that the table walked itself outside.
Nothing up there but stars, which is how supper ends up under them.
The evening is holding at exactly the temperature nobody talks about.
Jacarandas only do this three weeks a year, and the sky decided to match.
Grass warm, sky empty — the kind of Sunday that resets a whole family.
